Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_141030.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_141030.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_141030(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [7:0] start_x, start_y,
    input wire [7:0] target_x, target_y,
    input wire [3:0] iterations,
    output reg [7:0] nearest_x, nearest_y,
    output reg done
);
    reg [7:0] random_x, random_y;
    reg [7:0] tree_x [0:15];
    reg [7:0] tree_y [0:15];
    reg [3:0] tree_size;
    integer i;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            tree_size <= 0;
            nearest_x <= start_x;
            nearest_y <= start_y;
            done <= 0;
        end else if (tree_size < iterations) begin
            // Generate random points within a predefined space
            random_x <= $random % 256; // Assuming 8-bit space
            random_y <= $random % 256;

            // Store the random points in the tree
            tree_x[tree_size] <= random_x;
            tree_y[tree_size] <= random_y;
            tree_size <= tree_size + 1;

            // Find the nearest point to the target
            nearest_x <= tree_x[0];
            nearest_y <= tree_y[0];
            for (i = 1; i < tree_size; i = i + 1) begin
                if ((tree_x[i] - target_x) * (tree_x[i] - target_x) + 
                    (tree_y[i] - target_y) * (tree_y[i] - target_y) <
                    (nearest_x - target_x) * (nearest_x - target_x) + 
                    (nearest_y - target_y) * (nearest_y - target_y)) begin
                    nearest_x <= tree_x[i];
                    nearest_y <= tree_y[i];
                end
            end
        end else begin
            done <= 1;
        end
    end
endmodule
